records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Noticed you created a project already, which is great. Anything unclear as you're digging in?

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Blue Collective!
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Blue Collective* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Project created day 1 (2026-07-11), but no key milestone and no invite 6 days in, and zero replies to three Wrenfield emails ([email:3e81d2a4], [email:004835b4], [email:e3284ceb]). No tickets, so no blocker signal either. Starter, solo admin, 8 days left: engagement appears to have gone quiet, so unaided activation is unlikely but possible.

draft.subject: Next step inside your Blue Collective project
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

You've got your first project set up in Wrenfield, which is the main hurdle. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the work your team is actually tracking is usually the step that makes everything click.

If it would help, I'm happy to hop on a 15-minute call this week and walk through that first batch of tasks with you.

Best,
Chidi
